about: Script functions the xml2-fix dinput.dll registers for the forced-parties feature (research/heroes/FORCED_TEAMS_DESIGN.md 1.2; SPEC 19). They exist only when xml2-fix's forced_teams module is installed and [Game] ForcedTeams is present in xml2-fix.ini (registration: extended copy of the table at 0x68a908, push operands 0x49fe31 / 0x49fe36). xml1build merges them into the XMen2.exe API (xml2_api.json) for --forced-teams seat builds only; validate V14a cross-checks these entries against scripts_transform.XML2FIX_API.
xml2fix: forced_teams module, xml2-fix 0c82a6e (branch display; joinHero since 0c82a6e) - bump when the module's functions change
